Margaret Oliphant, The Ladies Lindores.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/margaret-oliphant/the-ladies-lindores

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Margaret Oliphant, the author, died 1897.

First publication of the text used: 1883 (SE colophon: 'The Ladies Lindores was published in 1883 by Margaret Oliphant.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1883, before 1931, so the United States rule for works published before 1931 applies. The edition's rights statement below also states the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die did so in 1897), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
